text: {"memo": "Microsoft Corp (MSFT) delivered robust performance in FY2024, with revenue climbing to $245\u202fbillion from $212\u202fbillion in FY2023. Net income rose to $88\u202fbillion versus $72\u202fbillion a year earlier, while operating income increased to $109\u202fbillion from $88\u202fbillion. Diluted EPS improved to $11.80 from $9.68, and operating cash flow surged to $118\u202fbillion from $87.6\u202fbillion. These results reflect strong top\u2011line growth and expanding margins: net income margin rose to roughly 36% in FY2024 from 34% in FY2023, and operating margin climbed to about 45% from 42%. The company\u2019s cash generation remains solid, supporting continued investment in cloud and AI initiatives. FY2024\u2019s earnings expansion and cash flow acceleration underscore Microsoft\u2019s resilient business model and pricing power. View: Strong growth and margin expansion justify a buy rating."}
